run_mdr_phonon_benchmark: run a phonon benchmark calculation for an MDR PBE dataset point with structural relaxation and force constant computation
get_phonopy_object: create a Phonopy API object from ASE atoms or pymatgen Structure with displacement and supercell matrix settings
produce_force_constants: run force calculations on displaced supercells and produce force constants with optional symmetrization
calculate_phonon_frequencies: calculate phonon frequencies at supercell commensurate qpoints or a custom set of qpoints in THz
calculate_thermal_properties: calculate vibrational free energy, entropy, and heat capacity using Fourier interpolation on a qpoint mesh
